Updation of declaration of unmodified opinion or statement on impact of audit qualification.

This is with reference to the Statement of Deviation or Variation in utilisation of funds raised through the Initial Public Offer (IPO) of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, submitted to the Stock Exchanges.
We wish to inform you that due to an inadvertent clerical/data-entry error, certain figures were incorrectly reported in the aforesaid disclosure. Accordingly, the Company is submitting the revised statement after rectifying the figures in the relevant columns to ensure accurate reporting of the utilisation of IPO proceeds.
The Company hereby clarifies that no amount from the IPO proceeds allocated towards the respective objects had been utilised as on September 30, 2026. Accordingly, the correct amount under the column "Funds Utilised" is Rs. 0.00 lakhs against each of the respective objects.
The aforesaid correction does not constitute any change, deviation or variation in the objects for which the IPO proceeds were raised and utilised.
